import json, collections, re
raw = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/raw.json"))
items = [o for p in raw["pages"] for o in p["items"]]
print("listings", len(items), "pages", [p["page"] for p in raw["pages"]] == list(range(1,31)))
byid = collections.defaultdict(list)
for o in items: byid[o["id"]].append(o)
print("distinct", len(byid), "dup listings", len(items)-len(byid))
print("dups differ:", [k for k,v in byid.items() if len(v)>1 and any(x!=v[0] for x in v)])
print("dup ids:", [k for k,v in byid.items() if len(v)>1])
print("statuses", collections.Counter(repr(o["status"]) for o in items))
print("keys", collections.Counter(tuple(sorted(o)) for o in items))
print("ts shapes", collections.Counter(re.sub(r"\d","9",str(o["placed_at"])) for o in items))
print("amount types", collections.Counter(type(o["amount_cents"]).__name__ for o in items), min(o["amount_cents"] for o in items), max(o["amount_cents"] for o in items))
c = raw["customers"]
print("customers", len(c), "missing", [k for k,v in c.items() if v is None])
print("regions", collections.Counter(repr(v["region"]) for v in c.values() if v))
print("disc", collections.Counter(repr(v["discount_pct"]) for v in c.values() if v))
print("id mismatch", [k for k,v in c.items() if v and v["id"]!=k])
ids = sorted(byid); print(ids[0], ids[-1])
EOF

cat > /tmp/recon/compute.py <<'EOF'
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
raw = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/raw.json"))
items = [o for p in raw["pages"] for o in p["items"]]
cust = raw["customers"]
lo = datetime(2025,3,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc); hi = datetime(2025,6,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
seen=set(); dups=0; regions={"north":0,"south":0,"east":0,"west":0}; count=0
local_vs_utc=0
for o in items:
    if o["id"] in seen: dups+=1; continue
    seen.add(o["id"])
    ts = datetime.fromisoformat(o["placed_at"].replace("Z","+00:00"))
    assert ts.tzinfo is not None
    utc = ts.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    inr = lo <= utc < hi
    local_in = "2025-03-01" <= o["placed_at"][:10] <= "2025-05-31"
    if o["status"]=="shipped" and inr != local_in: local_vs_utc+=1
    if o["status"]!="shipped" or not inr: continue
    c = cust[o["customer_id"]]
    n = o["amount_cents"]*(100-c["discount_pct"])
    regions[c["region"]] += (n+50)//100
    count+=1
res={"total_cents":sum(regions.values()),"order_count":count,"duplicates_skipped":dups,"by_region":regions}
print(json.dumps(res,indent=2)); print("shipped orders where local-date vs UTC filter disagree:", local_vs_utc)
json.dump(res, open("/workspace/result.json","w"), indent=2); open("/workspace/result.json","a").write("\n")
EOF
